$doc: User flows — the intent layer. graph.json is the mechanism (what every control does); this file says which journeys the product owes, in words a person can check. `check-flows.mjs` resolves each one against the graph by searching `advance` edges alone and writes the result to flows.resolved.json, the committed witness. A flow declares: `name` (kebab-case) · `description` (its intent in one line) · `start` · optional `waypoints` · `end`. START is either a board (`{board}` — the journey begins on that screen), a given edge (`{board, via}` plus `case`/`to` when that edge offers several outcomes), or a CONTROL (`{control}` — the click, not the screen: it expands to every edge carrying that label, which must all land on the same first board; `except` drops boards that mean something else there, and edges that only reach a gap are reported, never failed). END is a given edge `{board, via}` (plus `case`/`to`), the concluding act — an end landing on a gap is reported as blocked, not failed. WAYPOINTS are ordered boards the journey passes through; a waypoint's `via` (with `case` or `to`) pins the edge the flow LEAVES that board by, which is how an ambiguous leg is settled — to pin the very first step, name the start board as the first waypoint. Start and end edges are given, never searched, so their kind does not matter; every leg between two points is searched, and a leg that resolves two ways is a hard failure asking for a pin. FORMATTING: one flow per block, one waypoint per line, hand-edited. Never let a script rewrite this file.

flows.name: publish-a-post
flows.description: The bottom nav's New post opens the wizard on every tab root; pictures are cropped, described, and signed into the feed.

end.case: signed — the detail view, still settling

flows.name: edit-avatar-standalone
flows.description: The change badge on your own profile picture goes straight to the crop and its own seal — one signature, the picture alone.

flows.name: edit-avatar-via-edit-screen
flows.description: Changing the picture from the edit screen returns to it — one seal covers the picture and the fields together.

waypoints.case: come from the edit screen — the edit's one seal signs it

flows.name: narrow-the-feed
flows.description: The band's filter trigger opens the filter sheet; the sheet applies live, and tapping out leaves the reader on the narrowed feed.

flows.name: sign-in
flows.description: Email and password on the sign-in screen land a member with their key on this device in their own feed.

flows.name: reply-to-a-post
flows.description: A post's comment count opens the thread sheet, Add a comment opens the composer, and the seal signs the reply back into the thread.

end.case: signed — the thread, the comment settling

flows.name: open-a-topic
flows.description: A topic chip on a post opens that topic's page — the page itself is still owed.
